questionSnapshot.question: In Frozen, what is the name of Prince Hans' kingdom?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Hans wanting to rule Arendelle does not make it his original kingdom. Southern Isles is explicit in publisher synopsis; Weselton and Northuldra cannot substitute for that identity.
